109: We choose the right CRM with you, design your pipeline and move your existing customers in.

Invoices and payments link back to each customer; you get one live sales and cash dashboard.
110: You set the role, must-haves and nice-to-haves; the job ad goes out.

111: Meeting requests are handled and your diary kept free for deep work.

112: At period end it gathers hours, overtime, leave and expenses from your systems.

116: We map the records your current standard requires to simple phone checks and logs.

117: You set your buying rules and the assumptions to use.

118: Send notes and photos for the property.

Inquiries are answered and viewings book themselves into your calendar.
119: We set up the schedule of works and budget for the property.
Trades are booked and reminded; site sends daily photo updates.
Spend, snags and progress are tracked to a handover pack.

121: The contract is generated and sent for e-signature; a deposit invoice with a payment link follows.

122: The client gets a welcome, checklist, upload link and timeline.

123: A payment lands in your bank or payment provider.

124: At month end every open invoice is gathered by customer.

125: We load your contracts, schedules and job milestones.

126: A new customer asks for credit terms.

127: We connect your accounts, invoices, bills and payroll dates.

128: Each period the figures and missing documents are gathered.

Your accountant or CPA gets a ready pack to review and file.
129: Supplier invoices are read line by line.

130: Hire records and telematics are combined per machine.

Offers go to past hirers of similar kit, with your approval.
131: The customer starts a return online.

The refund or exchange is prepared for your approval.
132: You dictate or record (with patient consent) during or after the session.

You review, edit and sign it in your system.
133: Drivers' arrival and departure are captured automatically.

Charges go on the invoice with time-stamped proof.
134: We agree the areas to check — legal dates, insurance, finance, safety, people, systems — and who owns each.

135: Upload or photograph the document you use today.
We turn it into a digital form or checklist and an SOP task with owner and cadence.
Answers are saved, checked and routed automatically.
136: Purchases, stock movements, production and hours are pulled together automatically.

137: Your accounting app and sales systems are connected.

You get it on the 3rd working day; questions go to the owner of each number.
138: Costs, photos, certificates and tenancy evidence are gathered from the project as it runs.
Gaps are chased before the valuation is booked.
Your broker gets a complete pack; valuation and offer dates are tracked.
139: We set up the programme, budget, packages and approval milestones.
Site updates, quotes, invoices and changes flow in and are checked against budget.

140: Bills, subscriptions and renewals are pulled from your inbox into one list with due dates.

Family, school and travel dates sit in your calendar next to work.
Every Sunday: one short digest of the week ahead and what needs you.
141: Connect your accounts read-only, or drop in monthly exports.
Spending is categorised and upcoming bills are listed automatically.
Balances roll up into a cash and net-worth view that updates itself.
At year end your accountant gets a tidy pack of statements and receipts.
